tools.name: chandelier_size
tools.description: What diameter and height of chandelier suits a room, and how far it should hang. Over a dining table, the diameter follows the table's width instead of the room. Gives the designer rule of thumb; the page linked in the answer shows the sources.

tools.name: rug_size
tools.description: Which standard rug size fits a living room (from the room's size, leaving bare floor at the walls) or goes under a dining table (from the table's size, so chairs stay on the rug when pulled out). kind "living" takes the room in feet; kind "dining" takes the table in inches. tools.name: coffee_table_size
tools.description: How long and tall a coffee table should be for a sofa, and how wide for the room. Length is half to two thirds of the sofa; height is 1 to 2 inches below the seat. Gives the designer rule of thumb; the page linked in the answer shows the sources.

tools.name: curtain_length
tools.description: Curtain panel length, the stock length to buy, rod width and total fabric width for a window. Style is how the curtain meets the floor: float, kiss, break or puddle. Gives the designer rule of thumb; the page linked in the answer shows the sources.

tools.name: dining_table_size
tools.description: The largest rectangular and round dining table that fits a room with room to pull out chairs, and how many people each seats. Gives the designer rule of thumb; the page linked in the answer shows the sources.

tools.name: christmas_tree_size
tools.description: The tallest Christmas tree that fits under a ceiling with a topper and stand, leaving a gap above, and how wide it will be. Gives the designer rule of thumb; the page linked in the answer shows the sources.

tools.name: pendant_spacing
tools.description: How many pendant lights to hang over a kitchen island, how far apart, how far in from the ends, and how high above the counter. Gives the designer rule of thumb; the page linked in the answer shows the sources.

tools.name: bathroom_mirror_size
tools.description: How wide a bathroom mirror should be for a vanity (70 to 90 percent of its width, one per sink for a double vanity) and how high its bottom edge goes. Gives the designer rule of thumb; the page linked in the answer shows the sources.

tools.name: patio_umbrella_size
tools.description: What size patio umbrella covers a table and its chairs, from the table's shape and size, and how heavy a base it needs. Gives the designer rule of thumb; the page linked in the answer shows the sources.

tools.name: bar_stool_height
tools.description: What seat height of stool suits a counter or bar (10 to 12 inches below its top), and how many stools fit along it. Gives the designer rule of thumb; the page linked in the answer shows the sources.

tools.name: ceiling_fan_size
tools.description: What blade span of ceiling fan suits a room, from its floor area (two makers' charts), and which mount suits the ceiling height. Gives the designer rule of thumb; the page linked in the answer shows the sources.

tools.name: list_visualizers
tools.description: The kinds of products Renderior can show in a photo of the person's own space (furniture, sofas, lighting, patio furniture, vanities, front doors), each with its page. Use it to point someone to the right place to see a product at home before buying.
